title: Does alcohol kill your gains? 🍺
caption:
In one study, heavy drinking after training cut muscle building by about a quarter even with protein. Alcohol also disrupts sleep and adds empty calories. One or two drinks now and then will not wipe you out; heavy drinking often will. Cheers responsibly 👇

Muscle Building, Part 20
first_comment: Leg day then party. Bold strategy 😂 Who has done it?
sources: Parr EB et al. Alcohol ingestion impairs maximal post-exercise rates of myofibrillar protein synthesis following a single bout of concurrent training. PLoS One 2014;9:e88384
